job.job_title: Python Full Stack Developer (FastAPI, React & AWS)
job.job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Python Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Python, FastAPI, React.js, GitHub, and AWS Cloud. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting client-facing web applications and cloud-native solutions while collaborating with business and technology teams to deliver high-quality products.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support web applications and services.
Develop scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
Build responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using React.js.
Design and implement cloud-native solutions on AWS.
Develop proof-of-concepts and prototypes to validate business requirements.
Create intuitive user interfaces aligned with user-centered design principles.
Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend development practices.
Integrate applications with databases, APIs, and enterprise systems.
Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
Collaborate with architects, designers, product owners, and development teams.
Maintain source code repositories and branching strategies using GitHub.
Follow Agile methodology and software engineering best practices.



Required Skills

6-8 years of experience in software development.
Strong expertise in Python programming.
Hands-on experience in FastAPI development.
Strong React.js development experience.
Experience developing and consuming REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services.
Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience building component-based web applications.
Experience with GitHub and version control practices.
Strong understanding of web application architecture and UI development.



Preferred Skills

.NET development experience.
Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Node.js exposure.
SQL database development experience.
Cloud-native architecture and deployment practices.



Desired Candidate Profile

Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience creating user-centric applications and interfaces.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within Agile teams.
Strong ownership mindset and passion for building scalable applications.
